name: Memory chips (EEPROM, flash)
summary: Chips and cards that store data: EEPROM, flash chips, SD cards and USB sticks.
uses: Storing maps, books and data offline
identify: 8-pin chips marked 24C02 or 25Q32 on most boards; SD and microSD cards in cameras, dash cams, phones and drones; USB sticks in every office drawer.
test: Plug cards and sticks into a computer and check they read and write. Chips need a programmer to test.

decay.note: Lasts. Data on unpowered flash can fade after many years.
